item.title: TCS wins large deal from European bank
Infosys guidance raised for FY26
item.description: Infosys raised its revenue growth guidance for the fiscal year citing strong deal wins and continued momentum in digital transformation engagements across its largest client verticals, including banking, financial services, insurance, retail, manufacturing, and healthcare, as it looks to close out the year on a stronger footing than previously expected by most analysts tracking the stock.
